conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Division of Investigations, this is Officer David Miller. May I confirm who I am speaking with?
Uh, yes, this is Sunil Patel. I received a call telling me to contact this number about a problem with my taxes.
Thank you, Mr. Patel. I see here that your name is associated with an active federal tax fraud case. Are you aware of any discrepancies with your tax filings?
No, I just started working here last year. I pay my taxes through my employer. What is this about?

Sir, our records indicate that you underreported your income for the past two years, and the IRS has flagged your file for criminal review. Please do not interrupt, as this is a time-sensitive legal matter.
I really don't understand. I use the company payroll, and I don't do anything special. There must be a mistake.

Mr. Patel, let me be clear. Right now, there is an arrest warrant issued in your name for tax evasion and fraud. If this is not resolved today, local authorities will proceed with detaining you and freezing your bank accounts. Do you understand the seriousness?
Wait, arrest? I cannot be arrested. This must be wrong! What do I have to do?

If you wish to resolve this outside of court and avoid jail time, you must comply with the IRS repayment program immediately. First, I need to verify your identity for the legal record. Please confirm your home address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
My address is 128 Riverbend Lane, and the last four of my SSN are 3329.
Thank you, Mr. Patel. Now, according to your file, you owe a total of $3,700 including penalties. If you do not act, your driving license and work permit will be suspended along with the arrest.
Please, no, I need my license for work. How can I pay? I don't have that much on hand.
There is a secure payment option available. The IRS accepts immediate payments through government-certified gift cards or direct Bitcoin transfer to our secure wallet. Which method can you use today?
I have a credit card, but I don't know about Bitcoin. I think I can buy gift cards.

That is acceptable. Listen carefully: you must go to the nearest Walgreens or Walmart and purchase $3,700 worth of Apple or Google Play gift cards. Do not share this with anyone, as this is a confidential federal investigation.
That seems strange. Why gift cards? I thought the IRS would take payment another way.

Due to the nature of your case, the payment must be processed through the expedited settlement program. If you fail to comply, the police will arrive at your address within the hour. Do you want that to happen?
No, no, I will go. Should I call you back after I buy them?

Remain on the line while you purchase the gift cards. After you have them, you must read me the codes from the back for immediate processing. Do not disconnect, or it will be taken as refusal to cooperate.
Okay, I am going to the store now. It will take about fifteen minutes.
That is fine. Please confirm your current location for our legal records.
I am at my apartment at 128 Riverbend Lane, but I will be heading to the Walgreens on Main Street.
Noted. Once you arrive, buy the cards in denominations of $500 or $1000. If the cashier asks, tell them they are for your family. Do not mention the IRS.
Alright, I will. I am just worried. Will this really stop the arrest?
As long as you follow my instructions and provide the codes, the warrant will be cancelled and your assets unfrozen. If you hesitate, your case will escalate.
I understand. I am almost at the store now.
Good. Once you have purchased the cards, stay on the line and scratch off the backs. Read me each code slowly and clearly so I can process your payment.
